title: Two ways to feed
hook: An animal can obtain food from another in different ways.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: A wolf kills and eats a rabbit; a tick feeds on a living deer over time. Which interaction is illustrated as parasitism?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: A wolf kills and eats a rabbit; a tick feeds on a living deer over time. Which interaction is illustrated as parasitism?

claims.text: A wolf kills and eats a rabbit; a tick feeds on a living deer over time. Which interaction is illustrated as parasitism? The illustrated wolf consumes its prey; the tick benefits while feeding on a living host. These stipulated examples illustrate predation and parasitism; nature contains more complex cases.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A flea benefits while feeding on a living host. Which relationship does that illustrate? The flea feeds from a living host while benefiting at the host’s expense.
